description: For a university, hospital or other federal award recipient (name or UEI): how many of its federal awards have 2025-26 papers naming a listed vendor (BGI/MGI, Novogene, WuXi AppTec, DJI, Hikvision, Huawei and others) in methods, the FY2025 dollars, the split by list and by rule status (e.g. BIOSECURE no-grace vs grace-eligible, Section 889 in force), and its largest awards. Free: totals and the 5 largest awards. full=true: every award with the evidence sentence and paper link with a Tensorust key.

full.description: true returns every linked object and property. Needs a Tensorust key (Authorization: Bearer tdk_...). Omit for the free preview.

name.description: Recipient name or UEI, e.g. 'Stanford University', 'University of Pittsburgh'
